notes: 14 days maximum, reflecting the remaining two college weeks; earlier 21-day and 300-fixture assumptions are superseded.
No free tier, credits, Spot savings, domain purchase, snapshots, NAT, ALB, paid interface endpoints or Savings Plans assumed.
Worker-task hours include image download, startup, idle prewarming, retries and minimum billing. Maximum three concurrent workers.
Core hours apply to the state host and all three ECS service tasks. During downtime all tasks are zero and EC2 is stopped; the application is unavailable.
No retained Elastic IP. State public IPv4 hours equal EC2 running hours. CloudFront origin DNS is updated and allowed to propagate at each wake.
Cloud Map task registrations are priced for two registered API tasks while online, not for the full retention period. Keep the private zone to avoid recreation charges.
One private-zone calendar-month charge assumes all 14 days fall in October 2026; add $0.50 if the dates cross into November.
Expected upload allowance 0.25 GB: six 60-second fixture submissions total 126302472 bytes; short workflows and optional boundary checks share the remaining allowance. Avoid bulk trials.
Default AWS work demonstrates deployment/recovery/capacity only. Historical full scaling results remain local; a small AWS smoke does not prove numeric throughput targets.
CloudFront rates use Asia delivery. Direct signed S3 playback is a separate, non-overlapping egress quantity.
Migration/release overlap is conservatively charged at the largest nonworker task profile, including IPv4.
Storage uses a 30-day planning month; actual billing varies slightly by calendar. Metadata exports are included in S3 storage.
Expected 50k Tier1 requests include upload/multipart requests, source scans and up to about 10 failed/deleted prefixes rescanned once/minute for 20h. Measure actual request counts.
Conservative is a bounded usage scenario, not a bill cap. Tax/FX are visible reserves, not a tax calculation. Prior $200 currency remains unconfirmed.
Core billed hours include startup, CloudFront propagation waiting, readiness checks and drain, not only the visible demo.
state_public_ipv4_lifecycle: Auto-assigned public IPv4 only while EC2 is running; update CloudFront origin on wake; no retained EIP
